results.title: Scotch raises $20M to modernize liquor retail software
results.author: Ryan Patel
results.text:
Scotch raises $20M to modernize liquor retail software

# Liquor-retail software maker Scotch raises $20 million as vertical SaaS draws investors

- Ryan Patel 
- June 16, 2026 

 

Scotch, a Denver startup that builds an all-in-one operating system for liquor stores, said on June 4 it had raised $20 million in Series A funding led by VMG Partners, as investors keep backing software written for a single industry.

 Summary 

The round lands as Scotch reports it has passed a $1 billion annual run rate in gross payment volume and grown more than 500% year over year. If those figures hold, they would push the two-year-old company well beyond the early-stage pack in a retail category long served by decades-old tools.

## A corner of retail the tech wave skipped

Liquor retail sits inside the roughly $250 billion beverage-alcohol industry, yet many of its dominant point-of-sale and inventory platforms were built 30 to 40 years ago. “Liquor retailers have been left out of the technology revolution for far too long, stifled by the complexity of scaling an efficient operation in the three-tier system,” said Carle Stenmark, a general partner at VMG Partners.

Founded in 2024 by Jake Bolling

# Investing in Lightfield

Joe Schmidt, Alex Rampell, and Fabrizio Serafini Posted September 9, 2026 

Every company runs on a CRM, and almost no one likes the one they have. It’s the system of record for how you find, win, and keep customers—the most important software a company owns, and somehow the most dreaded. CRMs are supposed to help drive productivity and efficiency for sales and support teams, while helping deliver insights on how to improve. It turns out they often do the opposite, and the promised “insights” are a stack of dashboards you have to build yourself.

Enter Lightfield, the CRM for the agentic era. That means a fundamentally different data architecture: a flexible data model that needs no configuration, builds itself from your emails and calls in minutes, and fits your business rather than the other way around. The feat underneath is a temporal context graph that captures the why behind every deal.
